opportunitiesSection.headline: The high-value jobs you're losing — not the low-baller noise.
opportunitiesSection.intro: We searched GigRadar's live index of the Upwork crawl for US clients hiring in your wheelhouse. Then we filtered hard: payment-verified, deep-pocketed clients, real budgets, expansion potential. These are live postings — every one a client you could be talking to.

opportunitiesSection.lowballNote: ⚠️ Honest caveat: the median Upwork post in this category is junk — ~$100 fixed or ~$5/hr. That's the low-baller noise everyone complains about. The money is entirely in the top tail, so we discarded it and kept only verified US clients with $20k–$7.9M in spend posting real budgets. Here are the best of them:
opportunitiesSection.moreNote: Plus 5 more vetted opportunities in the full set. New ones surface daily — GigRadar alerts you within minutes of each posting.

opportunities.t: Clay / ZoomInfo / CRM Lead Operations Expert
opportunities.d: Build, clean & enrich CRM-ready B2B prospect data with Clay, ZoomInfo, Sales Nav, Apollo. "Not basic list building" — technical lead-ops.
opportunities.ltv: Highest spender in the set ($7.9M). This is your exact Clay wheelhouse — a clean data engine is the foundation clients keep paying to expand into full outbound.

opportunities.d: LinkedIn outreach to generate appointments for program managers. US-based profile required (you can be remote).
opportunities.ltv: $100k budget, 344 hires — a serial buyer running an outreach machine. Win one cohort and it becomes an open-ended retainer.

opportunities.t: Cold Email Agency Wanted — Long Term
opportunities.d: Build & run scalable cold-email infra to 100K+ emails/mo — domains, inboxes, deliverability, campaigns. Title literally says "Long Term."
opportunities.ltv: Deliverability + campaign management is recurring by nature. One deliverability win locks in a monthly retainer — your Outbound Architecture service, exactly.

opportunities.t: Fractional Outbound Sales Lead (SDR System Builder)
opportunities.d: Own the entire outbound engine: Close.com CRM setup, pipeline, dashboards, hire & train 1–3 SDRs, optimize performance.
opportunities.ltv: Highest-LTV archetype: build the system, then run AND staff it. Pairs perfectly with your BPO bench — recurring headcount placement on top of the retainer.

opportunities.d: Own a 1M+ emails/mo lifecycle program on Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Contract-to-hire. Founders previously sold MyCorporation to Intuit.
opportunities.ltv: Named, credible brand · perfect 5.0 feedback · contract-to-hire = durable monthly engagement with real enterprise budget.

opportunities.t: Product Demo Scheduling & Cold Calling (IT SaaS)
opportunities.d: Cold calling + demo scheduling for IT-monitoring software. Pays $500 per demo booked & attended. They provide training + tools.
opportunities.ltv: $1.5M spend, 281 hires, pay-per-demo economics. Hit the demo numbers and this becomes an evergreen pay-per-meeting pipeline.

opportunities.d: Be the discipline layer for a growing sales function: daily SDR/CSM check-ins, weekly pipeline reviews, CRM accountability. Explicitly part-time/ongoing.
opportunities.ltv: Ongoing-by-design = textbook retainer. 4.99 feedback, 188 hires, with a built-in path to managing a placed team.

opportunities.t: Cold Caller for Global Staffing Company
opportunities.d: B2B cold calling / appointment setting to test the channel for a global staffing firm. Open to your structured approach.
opportunities.ltv: Staffing = your BPO/remote-talent ICP. Prove the channel and you own outbound for them — and can place callers ongoing. Land-and-expand into your core model.

opportunities.d: Paid customer-discovery on AI workflows for agency operators — then a path into building their actual GTM motion.
opportunities.ltv: $200/hr top-of-range signals premium GTM budget. An entry into a SaaS buyer that values exactly your GTM-engineer positioning.

profile.overview: I build the outbound & RevOps systems that fill US B2B pipelines — without the US price tag. Clay Agency Partner (one of the first 100) and ~10 years in sales ops. I architect Clay enrichment workflows, multi-channel outbound, and clean HubSpot CRMs, then run them on a retainer with a documented two-layer QC process. Native-English, US-Eastern aligned, SOP-first. Most clients start with one build (a Clay table, a CRM cleanup, a campaign) and expand into managed GTM ops.
